# webdimens

> AppDimens Dynamic for the web: responsive dp/sp (sdp, hdp, wdp, ssp, sem) with the same math and names as the Android
> library appdimens-dynamic 3.2.0. Write units instead of px: class="p:16sdp fs@tv:28ssp", data-dimen="padding: 8sdp 16sdp",
> `padding: 16sdp` in CSS (PostCSS plugin), dimen('14ssp') in JS. 12 strategies, Android qualifiers (@landscape, @sw600, @tv),
> modifier classes (ad-a, ad-i, ad-power), resize, physical units, React/Vue/Svelte/Angular bindings.

- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): every topic with runnable examples (pt-BR: docs/pt-BR/README.md)
- [README](README.md): install, the five usage forms, strategies, runtime, performance
- [Examples](examples/README.md): runnable demo pages
- [README (pt-BR)](README.pt-BR.md)
- [Agent skill](skills/SKILL.md): decision flow for applying the library
- [API reference](skills/reference.md): every function, token grammar, conditions, formulas
- [Module map](skills/library-map.md): npm entries and Android ↔ web equivalents
- [Custom strategies](docs/custom.md): simplest form: write the formula, e.g. `cdp(16, 'base * pow(sw / 360, 0.8)')`, `scalingFormula('…')` or `scalingFormula((base, screen) => …)`; programmable factor `customScaleStrategy((screen) => factor)`. Full form: your own scaling law (`defineScalingStrategy({ id, reference, curve, clamp, rules })`, JSON shared with every AppDimens platform, free-form text formulas `{ type: 'expression', expression }` / `formula`, presets), used as `cdp(16, brand)`, `brand.css(16)`, `16cdp-brand` in CSS / PostCSS, `useScalingStrategy()` in frameworks
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
